demo.styles_description: Choose any homepage style you prefer.
demo.setup_description: With simple configuration, get a personalized official site combining static and dynamic content.
demo.step_homepage_p1: In the admin under Application Settings → Display → Homepage Layout, switch to one of the other layout templates (the current homepage is for tutorial purposes only).
demo.step_homepage_p2: Configure homepage details under Pages → Home → Edit Content.
demo.step_channels_news: 1. Select template Channel - Card Grid, add "News", custom URL: "news" (required)
demo.step_channels_services: 2. Select template Channel - List with Image, add "Services", custom URL: "services" (required)
demo.step_channels_about: 3. Select template Channel - Sidebar List, add "About Us", custom URL: "about" (required)
demo.step_channels_optional: The above are required. Add other channels as needed, e.g. blog, products, FAQ…
demo.step_site_intro: Configure site properties to make your website complete.
demo.step_site_colors: 1. Theme colors: configure primary and secondary (required)
demo.step_site_defaults: 2. Default values: update logo, default author avatar, default article thumbnail, company intro video, tagline, nav button text and link (required)
demo.step_site_sections: 3. Custom page sections: LOGO wall, sidebar ads, etc. (optional)
demo.step_site_header_footer: 4. Header & footer: Head HTML, header nav, footer nav, company info. Focus on header nav and footer nav settings.

brand_guidelines.name: Brand Guidelines
brand_guidelines.paragraph: Site colors are injected at runtime from the admin theme panel. Templates must use DaisyUI semantic utilities (e.g. bg-primary, text-base-content)—never hard-coded gray/slate scales or hex values.
brand_guidelines.tokens: The default “Business Tech Blue” palette: primary Blue #2563EB, secondary Slate #475569, accent #0F172A; surface base-100 #FFFFFF.
brand_guidelines.usage: Primary CTAs: bg-primary + text-primary-content. Cards and page surfaces: bg-base-100. Muted copy: text-base-content/70. Borders: border-base-300. Status: info, success, warning, error.
